question: Should the sandbox endpoint treat only byte-for-byte canonical CSP metadata emitted by OpenClaw’s encoder as supported input, rejecting all equivalent aliases?
rationale: The patch is deliberately fail-closed at a security-sensitive HTTP boundary; this is a contract decision about supported externally supplied sandbox URLs rather than a mechanical coding choice.

options.title: Approve canonical-only metadata
options.body: Treat the encoder output as the sole supported wire form and merge after the rebased head passes the required checks.

options.title: Preserve selected aliases
options.body: Define a supported compatibility form for any externally generated or persisted sandbox URLs, then add targeted upgrade and decoder coverage.

recommendation.title: Approve canonical-only metadata
recommendation.body: Treat the encoder output as the sole supported wire form and merge after the rebased head passes the required checks.
